# Airwaves

> Airwaves is a curated directory of live web radios, ambient sound generators, and scenic livestream webcams designed for deep focus, coding, studying, and relaxation.

## Canonical Information
- Website: https://airwaves.dpdns.org
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/SubhamPro11/airwaves
- Feed Format: Web Audio, HLS Livestreams, Direct MP3/AAC Streams, and Embedded Video Feeds
- License: Open Source (MIT)

## Core Features
- Ad-Free & Privacy-Focused: Zero commercial interruptions, no behavioral ad trackers, optional cookieless analytics.
- Multi-Channel Audio & Video: Handpicked streams grouped by vibe and genre.
- Keyboard Navigation: Global hotkeys for playback, mute, shuffle, favorites, and volume.
- Offline & PWA Ready: Installable Progressive Web App with local caching.
- Deep Focus Tools: Ambient nature generators, live space cameras, lo-fi beats, and classical radio.

## Channels & Collections
- Ambient & Nature: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/ambient
- Lo-Fi & Beats: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/lofi
- Classical & Cinematic: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/classical
- Jazz & Lounge: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/jazz
- Electronic & Synthwave: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/synth
- Livestreams & Webcams: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/live
- Talk & Vintage Radio: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/channel/talk

## Station Permalinks
Individual stations can be directly accessed via persistent URLs:
- Format: `https://airwaves.dpdns.org/station/{id}`

## Documentation & Policies
- Privacy Policy: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/privacy
- Terms of Use: https://airwaves.dpdns.org/terms
